label: GO after a2-rare-unrewarded trial, stronger with S2 belief, early episode
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * np.clip(-belief_lo, 0, None) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * np.clip(-belief_lo,0,None) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0)
explanation: Active only at GO. Magnitude is mainly set by the previous trial being a2 -> S1 (rare) unrewarded, i.e. the model-based stay-with-a2 case (about +0.42 over baseline). Within that it grows with the ideal-observer belief that S2 is good (clipped -belief_lo) and shrinks linearly over the episode (about -0.006 per trial, so it fades by about trial 70); it is a bit lower if the trial before was also unrewarded. After a2 -> S2 (common) unrewarded it fires weakly, only when belief strongly favours S2. Zero after rewarded trials and after any a1 trial, and at D1/D2. Uses only observed quantities (trial history, belief). Dev R^2 beyond timing 0.645, above the profile all-observed (0.45) and all (0.49) additive ceilings. The earlier model-based label used the policy (strong a2 preference); the observed belief term gives this up at little or no cost.

terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * np.clip(-belief_lo, 0, None)
(phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * np.clip(-belief_lo, 0, None)

issues: The belief is credited too much. The episode-trial interaction does nearly all the work. On test: last_is('a2 S1 u') alone gives 0.382; adding clipped -belief_lo gives 0.388 (+0.006); adding the ep_trial interaction as well gives 0.598. Without any belief term, last_is('a2 S1 u') + last_is*ep_trial already reaches 0.589. So belief adds about 0.009 test R^2, yet the label puts 'stronger with S2 belief' up front and the explanation credits the 0.42->0.64 rise to 'belief and episode-trial interactions'.

The a2-S2-u x belief term is a tiny effect. Its weight is +0.058, but it raises test R^2 by only about 0.009 (0.598 -> 0.607 when added). 'Fires weakly after a2 S2 u when belief favours S2' is real but marginal. The 'trial before unrewarded' term is similar: weight -0.064, about +0.006 R^2.

The claim that swapping the model's a2 preference for the belief 'loses nothing measurable' cannot be checked in this run. It is also doubtful, because the belief carries almost none of the fit. What replaces the policy is the previous-trial pattern plus episode position, not the belief.

Misses show one large systematic error class: false positives inside the a2-S1-u GO cell. In many windows the prediction is about 0.42-0.58 but the actual value is 0 (e.g. t18 after a t17 a2 S1 u; t23 after t22 a2 S1 u with an a1 trial before it; t1 at the start of an episode). None of these observed or hidden variables recovered it: the choice, state or reward two trials back, belief_cover, start_high, good, since_rev, unclipped belief, belief thresholds, or ep_trial<3 / >=50 steps. Each improves test R^2 by no more than 0.012. About 38% of the variance is left inside this cell. The likely driver is the model's internal a2 preference, which cannot be tested here.

Checks that do hold up: activity is GO-only; the main effect after a2 S1 u is about +0.42; the decline is about -0.006 per trial; test R^2 reproduces at 0.620; output is zero after rewarded trials and after a1 trials (residual table shows about -0.029 = baseline cancelled).
